# lua-sandbox

Embed Lua 5.5 with enforced memory, instruction, call depth and output limits, a whitelisted standard library, text-only chunks and typed host function bindings C++20 library `lua-sandbox`, namespace `trysac::lua_sandbox`, CMake target `trysac::lua_sandbox`.

- [README](README.md): Problem, install, usage.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model.

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Design notes.
